svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bracket: from 4 mm steel cut a leg 68 x 62 mm with a 15 mm flange

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on its front edge; bend the flange 90 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In the leg: a 21 mm radius bite at the back edge, centred 31 mm up,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clear of the turning tube end; a 14 x 9 mm slot for the pawl,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 21 mm from the front edge, 40 mm up. Two 6.6 mm countersunk

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes 7 mm from the back edge, 12.5 and 49.5 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stop block: 15 x 30 x 11.5 mm steel, screwed to the leg's foot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with two M5 screws; bond the 3 mm polyurethane pad on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pawl: 26 mm of 12 x 8 mm steel bar; chamfer the top of its tip

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 45 degrees by 4 mm; tap M3 in the tail for the solenoid plunger.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: leg flat on the left arm's inner side, two M6 countersunk

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws; the pawl slides in the slot, its tip over the lug.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the pawl slides freely 12 mm; pad top 0.5 mm under the
